_README: Amendment A19. Curated map from a human molecule's target class, and from its human indication,
to the companion-animal programs that already occupy that space.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. Competitor detection previously joined a human program to a
companion-animal one by sharing word tokens between their free-text `target` fields. That method
fails in both directions and cannot be tuned out of failing:
- FALSE NEGATIVES: dupilumab (target 'IL-4Ralpha') matched nothing, so the page reported no
companion-animal competition for a human atopic-dermatitis drug while canine atopic dermatitis
carries Apoquel, Cytopoint, Zenrelia, Befrena and five cyclosporine products. Ipilimumab
('CTLA-4') matched nothing although VGS-001 is an anti-canine CTLA-4 antibody. ZILRETTA
('corticosteroid') matched nothing although its own ingredient, triamcinolone acetonide, is the
active in GENESIS Topical Spray, which was already in the indexed list.
- FALSE POSITIVES, when the join was widened to ingredient and brand tokens: vutrisiran matched a
saline infusion through the token 'sodium', ivabradine and gemcitabine matched a dexmedetomidine
injection through 'hydrochloride', and Cortrophin Gel matched ear gel and laxative gel through
'gel'. A frequency guard did not fix this; treprostinil still matched inhaled anaesthetics.
Inventing a competitor is worse than reporting none, so token joining is replaced by the explicit
map below. Every entry names the companion-animal products it asserts, so a wrong entry is visible
and correctable rather than emergent from a regex.
target_classes: `match` is tested against the human program's target, ingredient and brand.
`holders` are the companion-animal products occupying that mechanism, from the supplied list.
An empty `holders` list is a POSITIVE FINDING: the mechanism is named, checked, and unoccupied.
indication_map: `match` is tested against the human indication. `companion_condition` is the
corresponding condition in dogs or cats, and `holders` are the programs treating it. This is
the crowding a developer actually faces, which is not the same question as who holds the target.
SCOPE. Holders are drawn from the supplied 328-program list only. Absence here means absent from
that list, never absent from veterinary practice; the veterinary-literature and pair-corpus checks
in x2_companion_evidence.py exist because this list alone cannot support a claim of absence.

halted.what: Terminated. Elanco recorded a $53 million impairment charge on a pet-health IPR&D asset (IL-4R) in Q2 2024, stating that management terminated future R&D activities over concerns about the asset's future commercial viability — not efficacy and not safety.

patents.what: Granted. Antibodies against canine IL-4 receptor alpha, priority 2015-04-02, for canine atopic dermatitis.
Caninized human antibodies to human IL-4R alpha, filed 2024-12-30.
Anti-canine IL-4Ralpha antibodies for canine atopic dermatitis, filed 2024-12-02.

target_classes.note: This mechanism is contested in dogs even though no product has reached the market. At least four companies have filed on anti-canine IL-4Ralpha - Merck Animal Health (Intervet) holds a granted patent with 2015 priority, plus caninized anti-IL-4Ralpha and an atopic-dermatitis fusion protein; Vetoquinol and Kindred Biosciences have their own filings - and Elanco terminated its own IL-4R pet asset in 2024 for commercial reasons. A mechanism can be crowded with intellectual property and abandoned assets while the marketed-product column stays empty, which is why patents and halted programs are recorded separately from holders.

holders: OKV-119 (exenatide implant), Okava — cat and dog, preclinical

target_classes.note: No companion-animal company program, but sildenafil is standard off-label therapy for canine pulmonary hypertension and tadalafil carries veterinary literature. Unoccupied as a branded program only.
Feline hypertrophic cardiomyopathy is the obvious target indication and no companion-animal program addresses it. Mavacamten and aficamten both carry canine and feline literature.
No companion-animal BTK program exists in the supplied list. Canine lymphoma is held by Laverdia-CA1 (verdinexor, XPO1).

holders: Palladia (toceranib), Zoetis — dog, mast cell tumor
target_classes.note: Toceranib is a VEGFR/PDGFR/KIT inhibitor, so multi-kinase oncology assets face an approved companion-animal incumbent even where their precise target list differs.

holders: VGS-001 (anti-canine CTLA-4), Vetigenics — dog, oral melanoma
target_classes.note: Abatacept is CTLA-4-Ig, a T-cell costimulation blocker, and is the opposite pharmacology from an anti-CTLA-4 checkpoint antibody. It is matched separately.

holders: VGS-002 (anti-canine PD-1), Vetigenics — dog, urothelial carcinoma
VGS-003 (anti-canine CD19), Vetigenics — dog, autoimmune disease

target_classes.note: No companion-animal anti-TNF program. Canine immune-mediated disease is managed with corticosteroids, cyclosporine and JAK inhibition.
Canine urothelial carcinoma carries a high BRAF V595E mutation rate, so this is a named and unoccupied mechanism with a clear canine rationale.

holders: Adoptive T-cell therapy (canine oral melanoma pilot)

target_classes.note: Epinephrine and vasopressin are emergency drugs in routine veterinary use with large veterinary literatures; they are not branded companion-animal programs.

No branded companion-animal program, but conventional cytotoxics are the backbone of veterinary oncology and carry large veterinary literatures. Absence of a program here is emphatically not absence of use.

holders: Unnamed UMSC candidates (canine and feline OA)

target_classes.note: Heart-rate reduction without negative inotropy is attractive in canine mitral valve disease, where pimobendan is the incumbent by a different mechanism.
Amlodipine is the standard first-line agent for feline systemic hypertension in practice, but as a generic it is not a branded companion-animal program.

indication_map.note: Feline arterial thromboembolism secondary to hypertrophic cardiomyopathy is a common, devastating and poorly served feline condition, managed with clopidogrel off-label. No branded companion-animal program addresses it.

indication_map.note: Canine glioma occurs spontaneously, notably in brachycephalic breeds, and is a recognized comparative model. No companion-animal program addresses it.
